prompt: A rectangular garden has a perimeter of 84 meters. The length of the garden is twice its width. Inside this garden, a square patio is built. The side length of the patio is exactly one-quarter of the garden's length. The remaining area of the garden is to be covered with topsoil at a cost of $2.50 per square meter. Additionally, a fence needs to be installed along the entire perimeter of the garden, costing $15 per meter. What is the total cost for the topsoil and the fence?
